title: My child has speech delay, can speech therapy at Pinnacle help?
metaTitle: Speech Therapy for Speech Delay | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: At Pinnacle Blooms, we offer comprehensive speech therapy services to children experiencing speech delays. Our approach emphasizes both verbal and non-verbal communication abilities.
html: Absolutely, rest assured that your child is in capable hands. At Pinnacle Blooms, our adept speech therapists excel in providing dedicated therapy sessions to children with speech delays. We utilize interactive exercises and techniques to encourage their speech improvement. Additionally, we also emphasize non-verbal communication skills, ensuring that your child enhances their ability to communicate both verbally and through body language and facial expressions.
